straight_delay_trace.finding: The filter removes the standing falls. The fall now comes in the 1 m/s cruise: from about 4 s the balance core carries a self-oscillation near 10 Hz in speed and pitch (speed RMS about the moving mean 0.017 m/s at 4.0-5.6 s, 0.19 m/s at 5.6-6.4 s; pitch 0.23-0.28 deg then 2.4 deg) that grows to the fall at 6.55 s, while the speed command stays 0.986-1.018 m/s and the yaw-rate command near zero. The filter lag first lets the range open to 1.42 m and the catch-up reaches the 1.2 m/s cap at 13 deg pitch.

conclusion: Smoothing cannot stop the falls without breaking the range requirement: 3 of 5 delay-variant scenarios still fall, the other 2 fail the range band, and the nominal stop dip deepens from 0.65-0.66 m to 0.55 m.
scripts: scripts/one_ov.py runs closed-loop cases (with the patch applied) and prints the metrics; scripts/trace1.py saves a full 200 Hz trace; scripts/lowcmd.py is the balance-core probe with small sine speed commands under a variant (checkpoint, shortfall 3). Run from the repository root with PYTHONPATH=.
